title: Fix default-features build of prompt-hub (argon2 OsRng)
objective: `cargo build -p prompt-hub` with DEFAULT features fails: E0432 unresolved import argon2::password_hash::rand_core::OsRng in auth.rs. Stash-confirmed PRE-EXISTING; masked because CI only builds --all-features. Fix: gate the OsRng import behind the feature that provides getrandom, or add a default-features CI job + fix root cause.
acceptance_criteria: a default-features build job exists in CI
